description: Start an AWS SSO login via the device-code flow (no browser spawned from this process). Returns a verification URL and short code -- surface these to the user so they can open the URL in their own browser and paste the code. After they auth, call aws_login_complete with the returned sessionId to confirm completion.

profile.description: AWS profile configured for SSO. Defaults to $AWS_PROFILE or 'default'.

name: aws_login_start
